axe_findings.title: Links rely on color to be distinguishable.
axe_findings.description: Low-contrast text is difficult or impossible for many users to read. Link text that is discernible improves the experience for users with low vision. [Learn how to make links distinguishable](https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.12/link-in-text-block).
